changes_made.explanation: Added Code Generation as TypeScript type inference is a form of code generation. Removed 'English' as generated outputs are code-related (method names, type annotations). Added TypeScript language and DeepTyper model which is evaluated. Added variable type annotations as generated outputs.
Normalized metric names to standard forms. Added all automatic metrics used in the paper for different evaluation tasks (clone detection, type inference, summarization).
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted in this paper. While GPT-3 Codex is mentioned, it's used as a baseline model for type inference, not as an evaluator.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. All evaluations used automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on code representation learning and evaluates on NLG tasks including code summarization (method name prediction) and code generation (type inference). All evaluations are automated using metrics like Precision, Recall, F1, AUROC, and accuracy metrics. The extraction quality was generally good but missed some important details about the code generation tasks and metrics used.
